title: Manufacturing and Selling Spurious Goods Resulting in Death

content.scenario: A food processing company in Kolkata manufactured and sold spurious food products that resulted in the death of several consumers. The company's actions were found to be in violation of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The company may be punished with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years, but may extend to imprisonment for life, and with a fine which shall not be less than ten lakh rupees, as per Section 91(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the punishment for selling spurious goods that result in death?
Can a company be imprisoned for life for causing consumer death?
